_comment: Voice/persona check on answers the AI composes itself (tool-fed + KB-grounded), after the persona hardening. Manual read: replies should be first-person, dry/sarcastic, no third-person self-reference, no narrating tool use, no hedging ('if you can read it', 'in case you were'). 30s cooldown -> delay_before 33.

steps.send: {bot}: is there a star I can fuel scoop in Sirius?
expect_absent: (?i)I ran|I fired|I just|just posted|if you can read

steps.send: {bot}: what should I do if I run out of fuel?
expect_absent: (?i)I ran|I fired|just posted|in case you were|if you can read
